verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS work-tracking product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Jira events. The pack does show 'Rich APIs', a REST/OpenAPI spec, automation that connects tools, Slack integrations, and an MCP server. These are inbound APIs, adjacent features, or chat-app integrations, so none of them counts as webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
